name: Molybdenum Diakyldithiocarbamate
description: Molybdenum Dialkyldithiocarbamate (CAS 253873-83-5 ), commercially available as Infineum T4294, is an oil-soluble organomolybdenum friction modifier used in lubricant formulation. It delivers friction reduction, antioxidant activity, and antiwear protection within a single additive. This versatile chemical reduces the need for multiple performance components in complex mixtures. In engine oil formulations, it reduces boundary friction between moving metal surfaces, directly supporting fuel economy claims. It is widely utilized in passenger car and commercial vehicle lubricants to enhance efficiency. Gear oils and automatic transmission fluids incorporate it to control frictional behavior under high-load and high-temperature operating conditions. Industrial lubricants for hydraulic systems and compressors use it to extend fluid service life by suppressing oxidative degradation. This ensures that machinery remains protected during long periods of continuous operation. In metalworking and energy sector applications, it provides corrosion inhibition in formulations exposed to moisture and aggressive operating environments. This makes it a critical component for heavy-duty industrial maintenance. Molybdenum Dialkyldithiocarbamate is supplied as a liquid at standard commercial concentrations suitable for direct blending into mineral and synthetic base oils. It is available in technical grade for industrial use. The product specifications are strictly aligned to lubricant additive industry standards to ensure consistency. Packaging options typically include drums and intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) for large-scale industrial procurement volumes.
